set.body:
Objective:
Close the review findings on the fmri-workflow foundation and header-first BIDS/lazy NIfTI ingest so the completed foundation is correct, byte-level verified, and credible at study scale before the out-of-core workflow epic reaches acceptance.

Context:
The initial ingest slice is functionally correct and cross-platform clean, but the current JVM reader performs one positional read per timepoint/voxel pair and boxes a primitive response block through Vector[Vector[Double]] before rebuilding DMat. The review also found untested NIfTI datatype/endian/scaling branches, an optional-confounds correctness bug, underspecified common-mask semantics, resource-close hazards, exact-double assertions, unchecked opaque casts, guarded Option.get calls, a dead OutputCollision preflight branch, and a premature pipeline dependency.

Architecture:
- Keep public response-source contracts scheduler-neutral and shared; keep byte IO, staging, and FileChannel logic in dataset/jvm.
- Introduce an ownership-explicit primitive row-major DMat construction boundary and keep hot loops allocation-disciplined.
- Plan bounded byte windows from selected voxels, bulk-read windows per timepoint, decode selected offsets, and scatter into requested output order.
- Use raw byte-authored fixtures as independent decode oracles rather than the production float64 writer.
- Keep workflow policies explicit in types and ensure unrequested optional companions cannot fail compilation.
- Use deterministic structural performance guards in PR tests; keep wall-clock throughput as an opt-in benchmark.

Epic acceptance:
1. The NIfTI response path performs no nested-vector boxing or element-by-element matrix rebuild.
2. Full/dense voxel selections use bounded bulk windows rather than one FileChannel read per element; arbitrary requested time/voxel order and Long offset arithmetic remain exact.
3. Independent fixtures cover uint8, int16, int32, float32, float64, big endian, slope/intercept, zero-slope semantics, truncation, and unsupported datatype/bitpix.
4. confounds=None ignores confound discovery ambiguity; requested confounds and all mask policies have explicit tested semantics.
5. Staging closes every acquired resource, unsafe casts/gets and exact floating assertions are removed, dead preflight/dependency scaffolding is reconciled.
6. Focused image/dataset/fmri-workflow JVM and Scala.js suites pass, followed by compileAll/testAll and a recorded representative read-plan/throughput baseline.
7. The final independent acceptance item verifies the implementation rather than allowing the hot-path implementation item to self-certify.

Relationship:
This epic blocks the existing out-of-core BIDS-to-group workflow umbrella and its final acceptance scenario.

Out of scope:
Memory-mapped IO, remote object stores, cluster schedulers, and changes to the scientific fit/group estimators.
set.title: Epic: harden lazy NIfTI ingest for study-scale workflow
